Which statement about amphoteric oxides is correct?
A
They react with acids but not bases to form a salt and water.
B
They react with acids and bases to form a salt and water.
C
They react with acids and bases to form a salt and hydrogen.
D
They react with bases but not acids to form a salt and water.

options.label: A
options.text: They react with acids but not bases to form a salt and water.

options.label: D
options.text: They react with bases but not acids to form a salt and water.
